sources.fact: 情态动词 · 能、可以；名词 · 罐。can 后接动词原形，不加 to；第三人称单数也不加 -s。容器义用 a can of 加内容物。
sources.method: Dictionary entry read; Chinese glosses, teaching notes and examples independently authored. Cambridge fetch returned 403, not used as newly verified evidence.

sources.fact: 动词 · 意思是、打算；兼有名词和形容词。询问词义可用 What does ... mean?；mean to do 表示打算做。mean 作名词可指平均值，形容词可指吝啬、刻薄或平均的，需按语境区分。
sources.method: Dictionary entry read; Chinese glosses, teaching notes and examples independently authored. Cambridge fetch returned 403, not used as newly verified evidence.

sources.fact: 动词 · 覆盖、包括；名词 · 封面、盖子。cover A with B 表示用 B 盖住 A；cover 也可表示课程或书籍涉及某个主题。名词义指封面、盖子或罩子。
sources.method: Dictionary entry read; Chinese glosses, teaching notes and examples independently authored. Cambridge fetch returned 403, not used as newly verified evidence.

sources.fact: 动词 · 相配、配对；名词 · 火柴、比赛。表示颜色或样式相配时，match 可直接接对象；match A with B 表示将两者配对。火柴和比赛是不同的名词义。
sources.method: Dictionary entry read; Chinese glosses, teaching notes and examples independently authored. Cambridge fetch returned 403, not used as newly verified evidence.

sources.fact: 动词 · 指向；名词 · 要点、点、分数。point to 或 point at 后可接所指对象；point out 表示指出。名词 point 依语境可指要点、观点、位置上的点、尖端或分数。
sources.method: Dictionary entry read; Chinese glosses, teaching notes and examples independently authored. Cambridge fetch returned 403, not used as newly verified evidence.

sources.fact: 动词 · 比速度、疾行；名词 · 竞赛、族群。race 可作动词，表示与人比速度或快速移动；作名词时既可指竞赛，也可指种族或族群。后一义与比赛无关，不表示优劣之分。
sources.method: Dictionary entry read; Chinese glosses, teaching notes and examples independently authored. Cambridge fetch returned 403, not used as newly verified evidence.

sources.fact: 名词 · 手臂；动词 · 装备。人体的手臂可数；机械上的臂状部件也可叫 arm。武器义通常用复数 arms。arm 作动词表示武装或装备，可用 arm someone with something。
sources.method: Dictionary entry read; Chinese glosses, teaching notes and examples independently authored. Cambridge fetch returned 403, not used as newly verified evidence.

sources.fact: 动词 · 喜欢；介词 · 像。like 作动词表示喜欢，可接名词、-ing 或 to do；would like 表示想要。介词 like 表示像或例如，不能只凭拼写把它们当成同一种词性。
sources.method: Dictionary entry read; Chinese glosses, teaching notes and examples independently authored. Cambridge fetch returned 403, not used as newly verified evidence.

sources.fact: 形容词、名词、动词与副词 · 根据搭配区分。light 可指重量轻、颜色浅或光线足；名词指光或灯，动词可指点燃或照亮。travel light 中是副词，表示少带行李，不是把所有 light 都标成副词。
sources.method: Dictionary entry read; Chinese glosses, teaching notes and examples independently authored. Cambridge fetch returned 403, not used as newly verified evidence.

sources.fact: 形容词 · 友善；名词 · 种类。be kind to someone 表示对某人友善；a kind of 后接事物，表示一种。词族 unkind 来自形容词 kind，与种类名词无关。
